The company says it grew to about six times its capacity at the start of FY2016-17, i.e. these were completed within FY2016-17 (Apr 2016-Mar 2017); 2017 is the announcement year, the exact COD per project is not published (PTC India annual reports on ptcindia.com fail TLS verification here). The same source covers 'Devenkonda wind farm' (49.5 MW, PTC) and 'Molagavalli (PTC) wind farm' (50 MW), which may be on the other list. The point (shared by 13 records, near Gandikota) is in Kadapa district, so it is left.
